_about: Hausa pages: what letters.restore_hausa (server) and page_letters.restoreHausa (phone) make of a line, and which words they mark. Read by backend/tests/test_hausa_restore.py and app/test/hausa_restore_test.dart, so both sides pass the same cases. Brydl's review, 13 Nov 2026.

cases.why: a capital K mid-sentence: hooked k, marked
punctuation around the word is kept
a comma after the word is kept
the line's first word may start a sentence (kafa is marked too: ƙafa)
a Wikipedia heading: the word after == starts the line
a list bullet: the word after it starts the line
a dash at the start of a line

cases.line: Ya tafi. Kungiyar ta kafa makaranta.
cases.restored: Ya tafi. Kungiyar ta kafa makaranta.

cases.line: Me ya faru? Kungiyar ta zo.
cases.restored: Me ya faru? Kungiyar ta zo.

cases.line: Ya ce "Ka zo!" Kungiyar ta zo.
cases.restored: Ya ce "Ka zo!" Kungiyar ta zo.

cases.why: a name: ƙano is not in the word list
capitals: a heading or a shout, left alone (still marked)
a small k is never changed, only marked
